title: Primary type
slide_intent: Teach designers to judge a display face both in isolation and in a real line. Its letterforms supply a voice while its spacing and weight determine how that voice reads at headline scale.
strategic_value: Bolt can give short checkout promises a consistent inflection with Agrandir Narrow. A worked line connects its letterforms to the product’s vocabulary.
demonstration: The page names Agrandir Narrow, enlarges six mixed-case letters, then sets a checkout line in the face. Medium and Bold character samples occupy two columns below.
practical_value: Compare the weights and read the sample headline before deciding how strongly the face should lead a campaign layout.
